messages:
sec-bot: ALERT: rule=KMS-Decrypt-Frequency fired 87 times in 5m (us-west-2). Spike vs baseline (x12). Samples attached: https://siem.company/alerts/1769001234 :rotating_light:

marta: seeing this now — we rolled out RBAC tweak last night, could be rollout noise but burst looks like retry loop. anyone have deploy context?

devin: rolled RBAC change at 2026-03-20T02:10Z, added service-account svc/ingest-batcher with decrypt perms. expected small traffic shift not 87x. I suspect client retries. @ashley any query you can run?

ashley: quick histogram shows many Decrypt calls from same principal with repeated request_ids. probable retry storm. query I ran: 
```
index=kms_logs action=Decrypt | stats count as hits, dc(request_id) as unique_ids by principal, bin(_time,1m) | sort -hits
```
If unique_ids << hits then it's retries. Proposal: change rule to require either >N distinct principals OR >M unique request_ids per principal within window. Also enrich alerts with recent deploy/change tags (rbac-rollout metadata).

raj: +1 for enrichment. Also suggest a short-lived suppression window for known rollout periods and a single-dashboard slice to watch "decrypt by principal" to avoid alert storms.

marta: proposed rule tweak: alert when (total_hits > 50 AND distinct_principals >= 3) OR (unique_ids > 30 for a single principal) within 10m. @ashley can you draft a PR with the new kql/sql + unit tests?

ashley: will open PR in 10m. Will include: query, test fixtures (retry vs multi-principal attack), alert payload examples, and a playbook binding: `playbook:siem/triage-retry-loop`. Also add enrichment join to `deploy_changes` table on timestamp window.

oncall: I'll subscribe and run the playbook now. Requesting a one-shot suppression tag for `rbac-rollout-2026-03-19` until 2026-03-20T03:00Z to avoid duplicates while we validate.

devin: added `change-tag=rbac-rollout-2026-03-19` to deploy metadata and notified infra. Also pushing a small backoff tweak to the ingest client's retry config to reduce aggressive replays.

sec-bot: NOTE: created incident INC-2026-0214 and attached 5 sample alerts + timeline. :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks all — monitoring dashboard (slice: decrypt-by-principal) and will follow up in postmortem if suppression impacted detection. Action items: ashley->PR, oncall->run playbook/monitor, devin->client backoff.

ashley: PR opened: https://git.company/policies/siem-rules/pull/342 — includes queries, tests, and dashboard panel config.

raj: adding a short doc blurb to the incident runbook: what to look for (same request_id vs many request_ids), how to add suppression tags, and how to revert rule changes.

marta: great. closing loop here — will schedule 1hr sync tomorrow if needed. :calendar:
